title: ChangesetResult
description: The working tree compared against HEAD: every changed file with its statistics and metadata, and no file content. Content and diffs are fetched one file at a time so that a changeset of any size can be described without loading it.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path of the worktree root the changeset was taken from.

isClean.description: True when the working tree matches HEAD. Reported so the interface can say there is nothing to review, rather than showing an empty list that looks like a failure.

hasCommits.description: False for a repository with no commits, where everything is compared against the empty tree and so reads as added.

untrackedIncluded.description: Whether untracked files were included in this run.

hunkCountsAvailable.description: False when hunk counts could not be attributed to files with confidence, in which case every file's hunkCount is absent. Saying so is honest; attributing counts to the wrong files is not.

files.description: Every changed file, in the order git reported it, with untracked files last.

changedFileInfo.title: ChangedFileInfo
changedFileInfo.description: One changed file, described by metadata only. Line counts are absent rather than zero wherever they are not knowable, because 'we did not count' and 'we counted nothing' are different claims.

path.description: Repository-relative path with forward slashes, exactly as git spells it.

previousPath.description: Where a renamed or copied file came from. Absent for every other status.

status.description: What happened to the file. A type change and an unmerged file are both reported as modified: to a reviewer they are files that are different now.

linesAdded.description: Lines added, absent when the number is not knowable — a binary file or a submodule pointer.

linesRemoved.description: Lines removed, absent for the same reasons as linesAdded.

hunkCount.description: Contiguous changed regions, absent when they could not be attributed.

isBinary.description: True when git treats the content as binary and will not produce a text diff.

isSubmodule.description: True when this entry is a pointer to another repository rather than a file. It is listed, and flagged, so that nothing is dropped from the change and nothing pretends another repository is source code.

submoduleFromCommit.description: The submodule commit recorded at HEAD.

submoduleToCommit.description: The submodule commit currently checked out.

isSymlink.description: True when either side of the comparison is a symbolic link.

isUntracked.description: True when the file is present in the working tree, unknown to git and not ignored. Always paired with the added status.

isNestedRepository.description: True for an untracked directory that is itself a git repository. Git reports it as one entry rather than listing its files.

language.description: Detected language, absent when the filename is unrecognised. Metadata only: nothing in this application parses a file according to its language.

project.description: Project or module the file belongs to, from the nearest manifest above it or from its top-level directory.

projectManifest.description: Repository-relative path of the manifest that produced the attribution, absent when it came from the directory fallback. The manifest is located by name and never opened.

changesetStats.title: ChangesetStats
changesetStats.description: Deterministic totals, counted by the application from the file list rather than estimated or asked of a model. The per-status counts are flat properties rather than a nested object because the C# record template in the contract generator cannot render a $def that references another $def — do not nest them back.

totalLinesAdded.description: Sum of countable added lines. Binaries and submodules contribute nothing, so this under-reports them by design.

binaryFiles.description: Files whose line counts are unknowable.

languages.description: Distinct detected languages, sorted. Files with no detected language are absent.
